# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 13 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-12 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level12_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 13 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-12 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-12, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-14+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-13 "Special" column reads "Channel energy 7d6"
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd, Archives of Nethys aonprd.com,
# and legacy.aonprd.com, all three byte-for-byte identical): Channel Energy's
# die count genuinely rises to 7d6 ((13 + 1) / 2 = 7, up from 6d6 at level
# 12) via the same pre-existing formula, not re-derived; base attack bonus
# stays +9 (13 * 3 / 4 = 9, an integer-division coincidence with level 12),
# base Fortitude/Will (good saves) stay +8 (13 / 2 + 2 = 8), base Reflex
# (poor save) stays +4 (13 / 3 = 4), and the Good domain's Touch of Good
# sacred bonus stays 6 (13 / 2 = 6) — all four integer-division coincidences
# with level 12, checked rather than assumed. Level 13 is exactly when a
# cleric first casts 7th-level cleric spells (verified independently against
# all three primary sources' raw spells-per-day table rows, which all show
# the 7th-level spell column newly opening at level 13 with a 1+1 slot), so
# the flat domain spell slot count genuinely rises to 7 (one each of
# 1st-through-7th-level domain slots), via the same pre-existing table-lookup
# idiom already used at levels 3/5/7/9/11 — no new formula invented.
